_comment: CLI argument-shape refusals. These are invocations, not walks: they never reach the transition evaluator, so they carry no pre/steps/post triple of their own and reuse clean-walk's files.

cases.name: positional-plus-transition-arm
cases.story: A positional population AND the transition arm. The two modes answer different questions and silently preferring one would make the other's arguments decorative.

cases.name: partial-triple-pre-only
cases.story: --pre with no --steps and no --post. A transition run needs all three; a partial triple is a typo, not a mode.

cases.name: partial-triple-steps-and-post
cases.story: The other partial shape -- steps and post without a starting state.

cases.name: trace-on-check-is-not-offered
cases.story: D6: --trace belongs to validate, not to check. Reporting what would be evaluated and evaluating it are different commands.
